notes.title: Doug's Deadly Dungeon!
notes.content:
[h1]Doug's Deadly Dungeon! DX3 mode now added. [/h1]
Earn gold by winning rounds in the main game, use that gold to enter Doug's Dungeon, explore the dungeons, upgrade weapons & armor at Smelt the Blacksmith, defeat the Scorn Souls at the end of each dungeon to earn achievements and loot! 
[b]Thanks for supporting 14F![/b] 
If you have time please feel free to leave a review of the game, it would help me out a lot! 

Play through of the First Dungeon

A 4 player local Beat 'em up which takes place in the same world as 14 Fiends!

notes.title: New Game Mode Doug's Deadly Dungeon coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Thanks to everyone for supporting 14F![/h1]

I'm working on a new game mode
Doug's Deadly Dungeon (DX3mode)
 in this mode you will be able to choose your path through a dungeon and if you can reach the end of the dungeon before running out of hero cards you can earn a treasure! 

Thanks again for all support 
-Ash
